setting.help: Grant each user access on their Access Rights tab, in the AI section.
setting.div: Messages typed in the chat are sent to your AI provider; do not type sensitive data into the chat. Odoo records the AI reads stay inside Odoo unless an administrator allows sharing (Advanced, in developer mode) and a user approves it. The API key is stored in Odoo and readable only by administrators.

setting.help: Changing provider or key loads that provider's available models.

setting.string: Let the AI read Odoo data
setting.help: The AI can search, list, count and chart records the user is allowed to see. Results are shown in Odoo and are not sent to the AI provider. Only model and field names are shared, never record values.

button.name: %(mcp_server.action_mcp_enabled_models)d
button.string: Choose which Odoo data the AI may use

setting.help: The AI can prepare new or updated records. Nothing changes until the user clicks Confirm, and only within the user's own Odoo access rights.

setting.string: Let the AI see menu and screen names
setting.help: Lets the AI explain apps, menus and screens. Menu names and form field labels are shared with the AI provider, never record values.

setting.string: Allow sharing results with the AI provider
setting.help: Off by default. When on, users can click 'Share and continue' on a result so the AI can analyze it. Each share needs the user's approval.

setting.string: AI data requests per user per minute
setting.help: Protects Odoo from runaway requests (1 to 600).
Upper limit for each AI answer (256 to 65,536). Reasoning models count their thinking too. Longer answers can cost more.
How long to wait for the AI provider to answer (10 to 600 seconds).
